cases.description: When validate flag is true the schema should be applied to a valid JSON object. Expect a successful ValidationResult with no error messages.
When validate flag is false the schema should skip validation and directly return a successful ValidationResult regardless of the node content.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation true with missing required property

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains "required" for property "age"
cases.description: Schema requires property "age" (type integer). When validate=true and the node lacks this required property, walk should return a failed ValidationResult with an appropriate required‑property message.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation true with type mismatch

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains "type" for property "age"
cases.description: Schema defines "age" as integer. When validate=true and the node provides a string, walk should fail and report a type‑mismatch ValidationMessage.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation false with missing required property

cases.description: Even though the node is missing the required "age" property, validate=false tells walk to skip schema validation, so it should return a successful result with no messages.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation true with array matching schema

cases.description: Schema is defined as {"type":"array","items":{"type":"integer"}}. A JSON array of integers satisfies the schema, so walk should succeed.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation true with array containing invalid item

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains "type" for index 1
cases.description: Same array schema as above, but the second element is a string. walk should fail and report a type‑mismatch for the offending index.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation true with null node

cases.expected: ValidationResult.success == false and ValidationMessage contains "null" or "type"
cases.description: When the schema expects an object (or array) but the supplied node is JSON null, walk with validate=true should produce a failed result indicating the null value is not allowed.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation false with null node

cases.description: Even though the node is null and the schema would reject it, validate=false bypasses validation, resulting in a successful ValidationResult.

group: walk(JsonNode, boolean) - validation true with empty object and no required fields

cases.description: Schema defines optional properties only (e.g., {"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"}}}). An empty object satisfies the schema, so walk should succeed.
Passing a Java null reference for the JsonNode should cause the method to throw NullPointerException before any validation logic is executed.
